title: Hip Hop and R&B Paint Party Experience
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Come catch a vibe with us! This Hip Hop & R&B Paint Party blends dope music, great energy, and a laid-back creative experience that lets you paint, laugh, sing, and genuinely enjoy yourself. Our art options are full kulture, our hosts keep the energy high, and if you have ever been on our Kulture Rides party truck… you already know we like to have a GOOD time.
We provide everything you need — you just show up ready to relax, create, vibe, and let the fun take over.

Why this experience is unique:
It is the perfect mix of creativity, connection, and turn-up energy. You get to truly let your hair down, paint with ease, enjoy great conversation, and vibe out to the best music.
